58 Orders in respect of certain assertions.
[F109(1) This section applies where a person has been convicted of an offence and a speech in
mitigation is made by him or on his behalf before—
(a) a court [F110in Northern Ireland] determining what sentence should be passed
on him in respect of the offence, F111...
F111(b) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

(2) This section also applies where a sentence has been passed on a person in respect of
an offence and a submission relating to the sentence is made by him or on his behalf
before—
(a) a court [F112in Northern Ireland ] hearing an appeal against or reviewing the
sentence, or
(b) a court [F113in Northern Ireland] determining whether to grant leave to appeal
against the sentence.

(3) Where it appears to the court that there is a real possibility that an order under
subsection (8) will be made in relation to the assertion, the court may make an order
under subsection (7) in relation to the assertion.
